notes: The Item 7 (targeted) section was empty, so all evidence comes from Item 1. Several items were left out under the rubric's traps or limits. 'Entrepreneurial, execution-focused culture' is a culture claim and scores at most 1. Partnerships with Shopify and others on action ads are advertiser tools, not small-business enabling. Roku City 'original storytelling' is an ad product, which falls under the brand-marketing storytelling trap. 'Inclusive content' and storytelling that represents audiences from different backgrounds is general language with no specific program. The Platform segment's reach (more than 90 million Streaming Households, 145.6 billion Streaming Hours) is disclosed in other paragraphs, so it supports the Creativity level 4 judgment but is not cited as an indicator. Howdy (nearly 10,000 hours) and Frndly TV (more than 50 live channels) are further owned content-distribution services under the same Creativity activity and were not recorded separately.
